items.heading: Analytical Questions Test
items.text: Analytical questions test how you think, not whether you know a fixed answer. Interviewers listen for a clear structure, honest assumptions and a check at the end.

items.heading: Practise One Question a Day
items.text: Practise one question a day for two weeks, thinking aloud and timing yourself. Record the answers and listen for filler, jumps and missing checks.
